Read-only consistency check of finalized CPU audits; write one receipt.

This does not re-download archives or repeat array-based numerical analysis.
It checks final coverage, source and preserved-file hashes, archive receipts,
per-plan numerical denominators, and summary totals from the completed audits.

record.scope: Local CPU postprocessor packaging; no archive data or GPU payload changes

live_incident_validation.scope: Observed event prefixes only; not final benchmark totals

result.scope: Read-only operational observations; numerical accuracy is reported separately.

compaction: Every per-unit audit JSON is bound by exact file SHA-256 and size, with archive SHA-256/ETag/bytes and before/after receipts retained.
Per-run episode IDs, counts, error maxima, event/manifest/provider/config/array-inventory digests, reset validation and integrity flags are retained.
Common pinned model/checkpoint/source and solver metadata appear once; identical values are checked across units/runs.
Verbose per-array inventories are represented by entry counts and a SHA-256 of JSON serialized with sorted keys and compact separators. All failing plan metrics remain in ood_runtime_audit.json.
Raw arrays, provider response bodies and signed catalogs are excluded. No numerical solve or API call is performed by this snapshot builder.
